notes.title: Just 24 Hours Until Release!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support with getting Littlewitch Romanesque onto Steam. We couldn't have done it without you! 

You'll be happy to know the game is arriving with Steam Cards (with amazing profile backgrounds as rewards), plus Steam Cloud save support so you can continue playing your game from anywhere. 

We've also worked hard to include the three bonus stories, originally released as a separate add-on purchase, as part of our release. No additional DLC needed! These will be unlocked upon successful completion of the game so you can experience the backstories of Domino and his companions. 

Littlewitch Romanesque releases tomorrow, April 3rd, and to celebrate we're having a special 10% off sale for all our fans who've been patiently waiting for its release!
